 Official: Atalanta confirm 22-man squad for FC Kairat with seven U23s 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Atalanta have named a 22-man squad for this evening’s Conference League meeting with FC Kairat, featuring seven U23 players, five of them teenagers.
 According to Football Italia, eight players are unavailable through injury for the Kairat clash and have not been named in the matchday squad: Odilon Kossounou, Isak Hien, Sead Kolasinac, Thomas Kristensen, Raoul Bellanova, Franck Kessie, Gianluca Gaetano and Giacomo Raspadori.
 OneFootball Videos
 Atalanta opened with a 3-1 home win over Pafos, then lost 2-0 away to Ajax, leaving them 15th with three points after two matches.
 Kairat drew 1-1 with Riga before a 5-1 home defeat to Panathinaikos, which leaves them 31st with one point after two fixtures. Kick-off is at 17.45 GMT, 18.45 CET.
 Goalkeepers: Marco Carnesecchi, Mattia Sonzogni, Marco Sportiello . Defenders: Lorenzo Bernasconi, Isaac Isoa, Albert Navarro, Relja Obric, Giorgio Scalvini, Davide Zappacosta. Midfielders: Ederson, Eljif Elmas , Javison Idele, Sergej Levak, Mario Pasalic, Lazar Samardzic, Federico Steffanoni, Nicola Zalewski. Forwards: Charles De Ketelaere, Nikola Krstovic , Jonathan Rowe, Gianluca Scamacca, Kamaldeen Sulemana.
 Source: Football Italia
